parent_objective: design mild warmup stimulus and near-boundary reveal task route after late reveal alone is action-only
blocked_by: M1401 action-only result shows late reveal alone does not create near-boundary outcome gaps
supersedes: running another late-reveal grid without a new evidence axis

public_gates: M1403 must design a mild warmup stimulus task route before implementation
M1403 must define how warmup evidence is created without actor-input oracle labels
M1403 must define near-boundary reveal and current/recent substitution controls
M1403 must not train, run PPO, run a source sweep, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run a new source sweep
do not add oracle mode/reference labels to actor observation
do not count action-only evidence as self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new task route that adds mild pre-emergency stimulus and near-boundary reveal pressure after late reveal alone is action-only
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: task/source design only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design requires actor oracle labels
stop if warmup stimulus becomes a scripted controller mode
stop if near-boundary reveal criteria are omitted
stop if design routes directly to training
fallback_plan: route to simulator/task API extension if existing config cannot express warmup stimulus
route to branch synthesis if no non-oracle stimulus route is available
route to another task family if near-boundary reveal cannot be produced

admission_evidence: M1401 found action sensitivity but zero accepted outcome rows
M1401 found zero preferred near-boundary candidates
M1402 routes away from another late-reveal grid
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1403 must design controls that prevent current/recent observations from replacing warmup history evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Task/source design following M1402 action-only audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If mild warmup stimulus cannot be designed without oracle input or scripted control, record the blocker and route to simulator/task extension or synthesis before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A mild warmup stimulus design can create deployable command-response evidence and near-boundary reveals without adding oracle actor inputs.
success_criteria: design specifies warmup stimulus, near-boundary reveal criteria, current/recent controls, source-diversity thresholds, and next implementation route
design does not route directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design adds actor oracle labels or scripted controller mode
design omits near-boundary or current/recent controls
design routes directly to training or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1403 passes if it designs a non-oracle mild warmup stimulus and near-boundary reveal route before implementation or training.
